versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Telegram Bot Factory skill.
- Supports development of various Telegram bots: Payment bot (crypto), Trading bot with charts, Group Management, Content Subscription, and Mini App backend.
- Provides detailed descriptions of bot features and development workflow.
- Includes transparent pricing structure for different bot complexity levels.
- Lists supported tech stack: Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Railway, and VPS.
